I can’t say enough how much I loved this hotel. From the beautiful grounds, the staff who were so kind and attentive… it was such a wonderful stay and I’m so happy I found this gem. There is a different level of service when staying at a luxury boutique hotel as opposed to a large hotel… You are heard and seen and no request or question goes unanswered. Their infinity pool was pure bliss and relaxation. The cleanliness and the comfort… my sister and I will be back again. Thank you, Team Ailla.

Ailla commands a lovely view over the marina. Taxi to the marina is 5 minutes and €5. Mucahit and Yigit the managers were extremely helpful with restaurant recommendations and places of interest to visit were really appreciated with their local knowledge. Always checking on our happiness with service. Staff were excellent meeting our needs Husame and Deniz attentively catered for us every breakfast and service throughout the day. Breakfast choice is varied with Turkish a staple with additional choices of various eggs, cereals and pancakes. Room 301 was very spacious and clean and copious amount of towels available. High end Aqua di Parma shampoos/Bath wash cosmetics are a nice addition and appreciated.

Could not be more satisfied with our stay. Premium service, excellent staff and providing a relaxing atmosphere to a whole another level. The reception is available to help 24/7, they help out with anything very quickly, from getting you a taxi to whatever else that you need. A special thanks to Yiǧit for going the extra mile and gather all information about what to do in Yalikavak and Bodrum, setting me in contact with other organizers and making sure we have everything.

Ailla Yalıkavak has to be one of the most beautiful hotels I have ever stayed at. From the moment I arrived, I was amazed by how clean, elegant, beautifully scented, and peaceful the property felt. Every detail created such a serene atmosphere. It truly felt like a home away from home. The room was spacious, the beds were incredibly comfortable, and the hotel was wonderfully quiet, making it the perfect place to relax and unwind. The location was perfect, just minutes from Yalıkavak Marina and only about 25 minutes from Bodrum Center, making it easy to explore the area while still enjoying a peaceful escape. The staff was incredibly kind, welcoming, and attentive throughout my stay. The dinner was absolutely amazing, and breakfast was a beautiful experience. Each morning we were served a delicious traditional Turkish breakfast, with additional menu options available if we wanted something different. The entire experience made my first visit to Turkey even more special. Ailla Yalıkavak is absolutely worth the value, and I’m so grateful I chose it for my stay. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a beautiful, peaceful, and unforgettable getaway. ~ @tiaratraveling

Truly an amazing experience! From the attentiveness of the staff to the cleanliness of the hotel, no complaints. The ambiance was great! The food was yummy. The staff was so helpful with everything! I can’t wait to tell all my friends about it. My room was so spacious and airy. The shower was perfect! The hotel is about a 6-7 minute drive from everything around the marina. As a solo traveler, I felt safe. Money well spent.

We had a wonderful stay and everything was perfect from start to finish. The staff truly go above and beyond to make sure guests have the best possible experience. Everyone was incredibly kind, attentive and welcoming, whether at reception or during breakfast service. The rooms are spacious, beautifully designed and offer stunning views. The pool area is absolutely gorgeous, with breathtaking views that make it the perfect place to relax and enjoy the surroundings. Thank you to the entire team for making our stay so enjoyable. We would definitely recommend this hotel and look forward to coming back!

“Excellent stay! The hotel was spotless, comfortable, and beautifully maintained. The staff were friendly, professional, and always willing to help. Great location, delicious breakfast, and outstanding service throughout my visit. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing and enjoyable experience.”
Excellent location, excellent food and excellent service- all staff are wonderful, friendly with great service. Thank you all for everything!
Amazing. Everything is just amazing.

Our stay in this wonderful hotel was the most wonderful experience from start to finish. It began with a seamless check in and a room upgrade to a spacious corner room with stunning views. The rooms are extremely comfortable and beautifully appointed. Breakfast was served to your table each day with a choice of eggs - the omelette was delicious and fresh fruit and honey in addition to traditional Turkish dishes. All of the staff were professional and friendly. The hotel is about a 10 minute walk to the marina and small town where there are a number of bars cafes and restaurants. There are a plentiful number of beach clubs a short distance away in a taxi. The pool at the hotel is tranquil and makes a lovely alternative if you wish for a quieter day. I can not recommend highly enough. My husband and I are well travelled and both agreed this was our best ever hotel stay.

We had a wonderful holiday with friends at Ailla. This place is absolutely perfect for relaxation and is exclusively for adults. The hotel is new and just 5 minutes from Yalikavak Marina, offering panoramic and stunning views. The rooms are spacious, comfortable, and spotlessly clean. The staff are friendly and polite. Breakfast and meals were excellent. The pool is quite large, and in my opinion, this is one of the best adults-only hotels in Bodrum. I definitely recommend it. Many thanks to all the staff for the excellent hospitality. Hope to see you soon!
Amazing everything was beautiful peaceful and clean. Wonderful breakfast, wonderful staff and also beautiful pool with fabulous sunset, just great.
Absolutely excellent hotel.
An absolutely amazing hotel & stay - beautiful views, amazing staff and amazing service.

Well, a beautiful environment, pleasing and relaxing with a few proud and well mannered staff. Staff at any hotel are there to serve a paying group of guests and to ensure a professional, safe and good experience. For the few who followed this mantra, congratulations - you will go far in the industry. After all when we paying between 130 and 200 euros for bottles of alcohol, the expectation levels are high. We did not, however, appreciate the dubious white lumps in your sauces, the towel racks falling off the walls, the unclosed room doors and the Blocking of Fire Exits. Strange really: the broken and disabled entry intercom system was and still is a problem. The lone guest with the dubious duffle bag will remain with us forever. The taxi company that you recommend will also never be used when we stay at a different 5 star resort in the area. The construction work next door, the slight tremors, the noise , the smell, the plateau, the heavy marble and the word 'safe' comes to mind. The other words, (to future guests paying between 400 to 1500 a night) are to be 'careful' of an un-manned night shift. Also, thankyou so much for spraying your dubious cleaning products all over our rather expensive suitcases and clothes. The scrams and bleeding cuts on the the hands of the day shift reception were a pleasure to see and the lack of any first aid box also brings the word 'safe' into our thoughts. We may re-visit you and thankyou for the information. There is a very good fish restaurant a few miles away and as there is no room service available in the afternoons and evening this may help any future guests you may have. You will go far in whatever industry you may have trained in.

Hotel Ailla Yalıkavak is one of the best hotels I've ever stayed in. The hotel is absolutely amazing, designed with so much attention to detail, the staff are incredibly welcoming, and the view over Yalıkavak is unforgettable. We highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Bodrum, especially Yalıkavak. We loved it!

The rooms are fantastic, 45 square meters, and everything is perfectly designed for comfort. If you plan to have dinner at the hotel with that beautiful view, it's a bit expensive. I think if we had eaten that fish at Sait's, we would have paid half the price we paid at the hotel.

A wonderful hotel where you can enjoy a child-free holiday to the fullest; clean, quiet, and high-quality. The location is fantastic. Very close to the marina, the rooms are large and spacious. You can relax with your spouse and experience high-quality service at reasonable prices.
